title: Project Config
subtitle: Defaults to the global settings. You can customize models for this project only — changes apply to this project only.
localPromptRefineHint: When enabled, it calls a text model to compress storyboard JSON/rules or the panel description into a concise prompt before local image generation (adds one extra LLM call).
localPromptUseDescriptionHint: When enabled, storyboard image generation uses the panel "description" field directly as the prompt (skips JSON templating). If refine is also enabled, it refines the description first.
progressPopupHint: When enabled: batch generation becomes a frontend queue (submits one task at a time) and only refreshes the currently running target. You can close and reopen the popup anytime.
localImageHint: Used for local ltx image generation. Size will snap to multiples of 64 to avoid reshape errors; recommended 512/768/1024.
fetchModelsFailed: Failed to fetch user model list
